capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2025 (the page read); model years compared 2025 to 2026, nothing shows a change. InsideEVs: 66.5 kWh gross (BMW global: energy content 66.45 kWh).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2025 (the page read); model years compared 2025 to 2026, nothing shows a change. InsideEVs quoting the MINI US spec sheet: 64.7 kWh usable (ArenaEV 64.6). 2025-2027 compared: no US pack change found.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2025 (the page read); model years compared 2025 to 2026, nothing shows a change. MINI USA: fast charging with DC at up to 130 kW.

published_10_80_min.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2025 (the page read); model years compared 2025 to 2026, nothing shows a change. InsideEVs: 10-80 % in 29 min according to MINI (MINI US: "just under 30 minutes").
